verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a design SaaS like Canva, but the evidence pack never describes what the free tier includes: no editor access, no collaboration and no seat limits. The only plan-related items concern developer features (resize via MCP is 'Pro and above'; private apps need Enterprise), and they say nothing about free-tier design work.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
